Equipment: Test Bench FINDR-QA-100 not established.
QUESTION: How do I view the event history on this panel?
SOURCE:
[S1] PDF page 2
For this fictional panel, the read-only event history is available from the front
controls.
1. Press VIEW on the panel front.
2. Select EVENT HISTORY from the displayed menu.
3. Use the UP and DOWN buttons to browse the stored events.
4. Press BACK to leave event history.
The EVENT HISTORY menu is inside VIEW. Step two selects EVENT HISTORY after VIEW has
already been opened. Viewing the log does not clear its entries or reset a fault.

[S2] PDF page 1
This fictional fire alarm control panel exists only for browser verification. The model
names, buttons and behaviour below do not describe real equipment. Confirm the equipment
label before applying any actual manufacturer procedure. This fixture supports read-only
questions about event history. It does not provide installer access codes, disablement
procedures, electrical tests or authority to impair a fire alarm system.
